get.summary: List ALL restaurants — active and inactive — for admin management.

put.summary: Update one or more fields of an existing restaurant. Only supplied fields are changed.

get.summary: List ALL menu items for a restaurant (including unavailable ones).

post.summary: Add a menu item to a restaurant.

put.summary: Update fields of a menu item, e.g. price or availability. Only supplied fields are changed.

delete.summary:
Delete a menu item. Rejected with 409 if the item appears in any historical order —
in that case set IsAvailable=false via the update endpoint instead.

post.summary: Register a new user. Set `isAdmin` to true for Admin, false for User. Returns a JWT on success.
Login with email and password. Returns a JWT token on success.

get.summary: Get the current user's cart. Returns an empty cart if none exists yet.

delete.summary: Empty the cart entirely (also frees it to accept a different restaurant next).

post.summary:
Add a menu item to the cart, or increment quantity if it's already there.
A cart can only contain items from one restaurant at a time.

delete.summary: Remove a single menu item from the cart.

post.summary: Place an order from the current user's cart. Empties the cart on success.

get.summary: Get the current user's order history (newest first).
Get a specific order belonging to the current user (including its current status).
List ALL orders across the system. Optional filters by status and restaurant.

parameters.name: restaurantId
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict to a single restaurant.

patch.summary: Admin updates the status of an order. Delivered / Cancelled orders are terminal and can't be changed.

get.summary: List all ACTIVE restaurants. Visible to any logged-in user.
Get details of a single active restaurant.
List the available menu items for an active restaurant.

AddCartItemRequest.description: Request model for adding an item to cart.

role.description: Application role name: User or Admin.

AuthResponse.description: JWT and user profile returned after successful auth.

AuthSuccessResponse.description: Successful register/login payload: human-readable message plus auth data.

CartItemViewModel.description:
ViewModel for a single cart item.
Represents cart item data without navigation to Cart or MenuItem entities.

CartViewModel.description:
ViewModel for displaying the user's cart.
Contains restaurant reference and list of items without any navigation properties.

CreateMenuItemRequest.description: Request model for creating a new menu item.

CreateRestaurantRequest.description: Request model for creating a new restaurant.

ErrorMessageResponse.description: Simple error body for failed login or business-rule failures.

MenuItemViewModel.description:
ViewModel for displaying menu item information.
No navigation to Restaurant entity.

OrderItemViewModel.description:
ViewModel for displaying a single order item in the response.
Contains item-specific details without any navigation properties.

OrderViewModel.description:
ViewModel for displaying order details.
Flattens restaurant and user data into simple properties (no navigation properties).

isAdmin.description: If true, the account is created as Admin; if false (default), as User.

RegisterRequest.description: Register payload. Role is derived from startup_project.Models.RegisterRequest.IsAdmin (not from a free-text role).

RestaurantViewModel.description:
ViewModel for displaying restaurant information.
No navigation properties to MenuItem or Order collections.

UpdateMenuItemRequest.description: Request model for updating menu item information.

UpdateOrderStatusRequest.description: Request model for updating order status.

UpdateRestaurantRequest.description:
Request model for updating restaurant information.
Partial update — only non-null fields are applied.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT token. Example: eyJhbGci...
